author: Akihiro-Tabuchi
title: OpenVINO GenAI job fails because sccache Azure connection string is not trailing-slash-sanitized
signature: sccache server startup failed cache storage failed to read unexpected permanent at read azbloberror code invaliduri message the requested uri does not represent any resource on the server|Configuration

failed_jobs.name: Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: CMake configure fails: C compiler check broken because sccache server fails to start (Azure blob InvalidUri on .sccache_check)

failed_jobs.name: LLM accuracy iGPU tests / LLM accuracy GPU tests
failed_jobs.symptom: 2 of 4 Qwen2-0.5B-Instruct accuracy_conformance tests fail with huggingface_hub 429 Too Many Requests (rate limited, unrelated transient issue, already superseded by attempt 2 in_progress)

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status_ubuntu_24
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status gate job fails (exit 1) because required jobs above failed

key_errors: CMake Error at /usr/share/cmake-3.28/Modules/CMakeTestCCompiler.cmake:67 (message): The C compiler "/usr/bin/cc" is not able to compile a simple test program.

sccache: error: Server startup failed: cache storage failed to read: Unexpected (permanent) at read => AzblobError { code: "InvalidUri", message: "The requested URI does not represent any resource on the server. RequestId:04e3aa10-301e-00a1-3886-702b4d000000 Time:2026-11-09T20:10:21.6223781Z" }
root_cause: The non-blocking C++20 build job sets CMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER/CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER to sccache with SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING configured for the ghasccacheblobs storage account. The resulting blob URI constructed by sccache contains a double slash ("...blob.core.windows.net//sccache/..."), which Azure Blob Storage rejects with HTTP 400 InvalidUri. This causes the very first sccache-wrapped compiler invocation (CMakeTestCCompiler's try-compile) to fail, so CMake reports the C compiler as broken and configuration aborts before any real compilation happens. This is the third occurrence of the exact same signature (runs 42198977524 and 42234699742 on 2026-11-06), confirming a persistent, deterministic misconfiguration of the sccache Azure connection string/prefix (likely a trailing slash or empty path segment in SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX or the connection string's BlobEndpoint) rather than a one-off outage.
reproduction_steps: N/A directly (requires the CI runner's SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING secret and ghasccacheblobs storage account). To reproduce locally: set SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING to a value whose BlobEndpoint ends with a trailing slash (or whose SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX produces an empty path segment), run `sccache --start-server`, then invoke `sccache cc -c test.c -o test.o`; observe the same AzblobError InvalidUri on the resulting double-slash URI.
recommended_actions: Inspect the sccache Azure connection string / BlobEndpoint used by the 'ubuntu_24.yml' -> non-blocking C++20 build job for a trailing slash before the container path, and strip it (this is the same root cause already flagged for pattern 08b993dbdc18ccac on runs 42198977524/42234699742).

Add a CI-side sanity check that fails fast with a clear message if the sccache server cannot start, instead of surfacing it as an opaque 'C compiler is not able to compile a simple test program' CMake error.
Verify SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX ('ubuntu_24_04_x86_64_Release_cpp20') concatenation with the connection string's container/path does not introduce a double slash.

Since this build job is already 'non-blocking', confirm the merge-queue gate correctly treats it as non-blocking so a transient/config sccache failure here does not gate the merge (current run's overall-status job still failed; verify this is intentional for a required job elsewhere, not this one).
prevention_strategies: Add a smoke-test step (or pre-flight CI check) that calls `sccache --start-server` and verifies connectivity to the Azure blob cache before the full CMake configure runs, failing with a specific, actionable message referencing the exact storage URI rather than letting it masquerade as a C-compiler failure three layers down. Pin/validate the SCCACHE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING and SCCACHE_AZURE_KEY_PREFIX format in the workflow's reusable job definition (job_build_linux_cpp20.yml) with a regex check for trailing slashes.
historical_context: Identical signature (08b993dbdc18ccac) previously recorded twice: 2026-11-06T11:53:20Z (run 42198977524, PR #39101) and 2026-11-06T16:06:09Z (run 42234699742, PR #39101). This is the 3rd occurrence overall but the first in the last 12 hours relative to this run, so no notify_teams_recurring escalation is triggered this time.
